raw.label: Balanced app
raw.description: Continuous, Notes, Triggers, and Mic sit at matching perceived weight.

raw.label: Soft canopy
raw.description: Lower event gain and a wider mic smear for gentler branching.

raw.label: Percussive grid
raw.description: Tighter divisions with note and trigger events pushed forward.

raw.label: Recursive wet
raw.description: Mic and sustained branches are louder, with a denser delayed tail.

raw.label: Soft FM kit
raw.description: Each fixed tile identity chooses an FM drum body; color shifts pitch and modulation. The moving empty cell is always a hard rest.

raw.label: Analog kit
raw.description: Sine, triangle, and square attacks follow tile identity while color changes the pitch drop, waveform, and brightness.

raw.label: Modal colors
raw.description: Every tile strikes a tuned three-part resonator. Tile identity follows the selected scale and color changes its inharmonic body.

raw.label: Noise grid
raw.description: Colored filter bursts turn tile identity, row, and column into a dry spatial rhythm. The gap remains completely silent.

raw.label: 303 acid
raw.description: The selected scale becomes a resonant acid line. Green and blue tiles glide; red and yellow tiles accent; the empty cell gates the voice off.

raw.label: Dijkstra
raw.description: A weighted frontier spreads across the graph until its cheapest path locks in.

raw.label: Towers of Hanoi
raw.description: Recursive disk transfers ring between three spatially separated pegs.

raw.label: Minimax + Alpha-Beta
raw.description: Competing evaluations climb the tree while alpha-beta cuts whole branches silent.

raw.label: N-Queens
raw.description: Queens accumulate as harmony, collide as noise, and unwind through backtracking.

raw.label: Euclidean GCD
raw.description: Remainders descend while each quotient stamps out a compact rhythmic cell.

raw.label: Bubble Sort
raw.description: Adjacent comparisons push larger values toward the end in repeated passes.

raw.label: Insertion Sort
raw.description: Each new value walks backward until it settles into the ordered prefix.

raw.label: Selection Sort
raw.description: A scanning voice finds each minimum before swapping it into place.

raw.label: Merge Sort
raw.description: Small ordered phrases combine into progressively longer merged sections.

raw.label: Quick Sort
raw.description: Pivot comparisons divide the field into recursively smaller partitions.

raw.label: Synthetic · low four-note coo
raw.description: Four slow, low-frequency tonal phrases

raw.label: Calm water
raw.description: Stable underwater transmission with a restrained, polarity-inverting pressure-release surface reflection.

raw.label: Open air
raw.description: A comparatively stable above-water path with stronger distance-dependent high-frequency loss than calm water.

raw.label: Windy air
raw.description: An above-water comparison with turbulent flutter, moving path length, and stronger high-frequency loss.

raw.label: Choppy surface water
raw.description: A near-surface underwater comparison with moving, polarity-inverting multipath and scattering-like flutter.

raw.label: Quarter · eighth · eighth
raw.description: A long first space followed by two quicker replies.

raw.label: Tresillo 3–3–2
raw.description: Three unevenly spaced impulses across four beats.

raw.label: Two close · one far
raw.description: A close double gesture answered after a larger breath-shaped gap.

raw.label: Five-step lilt
raw.description: A compact asymmetric loop that continually turns against a four-beat breath.

raw.label: Soft / hard / ghost
raw.description: Velocity variation makes the repetition breathe instead of clicking like a metronome.

raw.label: Sparse seven
raw.description: A seven-step loop with unequal rests and three differently weighted gestures.

raw.label: Lesiba / gora
raw.description: A flattened quill converts forceful inhalation and exhalation into transverse string motion; the mouth selects harmonics from the sounding string.
raw.modelNote: Signed Bernoulli-style quill forcing drives a lossy harmonic string. Inhalation and exhalation use different quill phase and spectral loading.

raw.label: Harmonica
raw.description: Blow and draw pressure select opposing free reeds. The vocal tract feeds a strongly nonlinear, player-controlled acoustic load back to the reeds.
raw.modelNote: Pressure-controlled reed oscillators use a nonlinear opening/flow curve and direction-dependent reed banks.

raw.label: Khaen
raw.description: A mouth chamber distributes inhaled or exhaled flow through bamboo pipes whose free reeds sound in either direction.
raw.modelNote: Bidirectional reed valves feed a multi-pipe modal bank; breath direction changes attack and spectral balance without stopping the chord.

raw.label: Sheng
raw.description: Metal free reeds mounted in a wind chamber couple to tuned bamboo pipes and respond on both blown and drawn airflow.
raw.modelNote: A bidirectional free-reed bank is coupled to pipe modes; chamber and mouth impedances color the radiated chord.

raw.label: Shō
raw.description: Seventeen slender pipes form sustained aitake tone clusters, maintained through alternating outward and inward breath.
raw.modelNote: Long-attack bidirectional reeds excite a bright, tightly spaced pipe cluster; direction alters the transient more than pitch.

raw.label: Hulusi
raw.description: Exhaled air enters a gourd wind chest and drives a melody-pipe free reed plus one or more drone pipes.
raw.modelNote: An outward-pressure reed valve feeds one fingered pipe and two weak drone resonances through a shared chamber.

raw.label: Bawu
raw.description: A side-blown bamboo pipe uses an enclosed free reed as its pressure valve, with finger holes setting the air-column resonance.
raw.modelNote: One outward-driven reed is impedance-locked to a lossy pipe mode and colored by the mouth cavity upstream.

raw.label: Didgeridoo / yidaki
raw.description: Exhaled pressure opens and closes the lips against a long irregular bore while the player's vocal-tract impedance sculpts its spectral peaks.
raw.modelNote: A pressure-driven lip valve feeds odd bore modes; movable vocal-tract impedance notches and glottal pulses reshape the drone.
raw.sourceLabel: Fletcher et al., JASA physical model

raw.label: Pungi / been
raw.description: Continuous exhalation pressurizes a gourd reservoir that supplies a melody reed and drone reed in parallel pipes.
raw.modelNote: A smoothed reservoir pressure drives paired beating reeds, one fingered and one droning, through gourd resonances.

raw.label: Nose flute
raw.description: A controlled nasal jet crosses an edge and locks to a bamboo air column; mouth volume can indirectly alter upstream pressure and phrasing.
raw.modelNote: Jet-delay oscillation is approximated by a noisy edge-tone source locked to pipe modes; only exhalation excites it.

raw.label: Overtone flute
raw.description: A narrow end-blown pipe changes register primarily through breath pressure, exposing successive air-column modes without finger holes.
raw.modelNote: Jet speed moves the strongest coupling window upward through a harmonic pipe bank, producing pressure-selected registers.

raw.label: ʻUkeke
raw.description: Three strings are plucked while the lips and oral cavity act as a moving resonator, silently articulating changes in timbre.
raw.modelNote: A plucked modal string bank decays independently; signed breath changes acoustic loading and turbulence, not the initial excitation.

raw.label: Umrhubhe
raw.description: A friction stick excites the bow string while the mouth cavity selects and amplifies harmonics from the sustained vibration.
raw.modelNote: Stick-slip forcing sustains a string modal bank; the mouth resonator supplies the strongest audible spectral movement.

raw.label: Lunku mouth bow
raw.description: A twanged string supplies a harmonic spectrum while the bow is pressed to the mouth, turning the oral cavity into its resonator.
raw.modelNote: A short pluck excites string modes; jaw, tongue, and lip controls move the radiating formants.

raw.label: Berimbau-de-boca
raw.description: Unlike the gourd-resonated capoeira berimbau, this mouth-bow form couples its plucked string directly to a changing oral resonator.
raw.modelNote: Plucked string modes feed a vowel-like impedance filter; breath adds load and aspiration but does not replace the pluck.

raw.label: K’ni
raw.description: A bowed string sends vibration along a cord held at the mouth; the player's oral cavity becomes a highly articulate remote resonator.
raw.modelNote: Bowed stick-slip energy sustains string modes and a coupling cord injects them into movable oral formants.

raw.label: Makomako jaw harp
raw.description: A split-bamboo lamella is finger-excited at the lips; inhaled and exhaled air load its motion differently while the mouth selects harmonics.
raw.modelNote: A plucked lamella supplies the initial energy and signed pressure sustains, bends, and redistributes its harmonic modes.

raw.label: Mukkuri
raw.description: A cord-plucked bamboo tongue vibrates before the mouth, whose shape and alternating airflow reveal and animate its upper partials.
raw.modelNote: A plucked bamboo lamella is pressure-loaded in both directions and radiated through a movable three-formant cavity.

raw.label: Đàn môi
raw.description: A light brass lamella rests against the lips rather than the teeth; pluck, signed airflow, and oral articulation all strongly affect its sound.
raw.modelNote: A bright plucked lamella receives bidirectional aerodynamic sustain and close-coupled vocal-tract filtering.

raw.label: Brass Choir

raw.label: Bell Tower
raw.description: Four inharmonic stages from 110 Hz with a slight ratio offset and rising taper for metallic shimmer.

raw.label: Neon Reed
raw.description: Six tight stages at 82 Hz with low-index modulation and gentle taper — buzzy and reedy.

raw.label: Glass Forest
raw.description: Three widely spread stages from 110 Hz produce glassy, shifting overtones.

raw.label: Organ Pulse
raw.description: Eight even octave-ish stages from 65 Hz with falling taper emulate a pipe organ chorus.

raw.label: Electric Wind
raw.description: Five wide-ratio stages at 110 Hz with high index and fast taper — electric and chaotic.

raw.label: Long Bloom
raw.description: Four widely spaced stages open around a 72 Hz bass over a calm 20-second cycle.

raw.label: Low Lantern
raw.description: Two audio-rate operators hold a warm 54 Hz drone with a light phase halo and no deep-chain growl.

raw.label: Soft Alloy
raw.description: Three golden-ratio stages sustain a clear 99 Hz drone with a fine, inharmonic shimmer.

raw.label: Glass Current
raw.description: Five stages brighten and recede around 132 Hz, completing the slowest turn every 3.6 seconds.

raw.label: Quickening Coil
raw.description: Six strengthening hand-offs swell around 107 Hz on a quicker 1.1-second cycle.

raw.label: Clockwork Lace

raw.label: Feedback Nest

raw.label: Slow Furnace

raw.label: Glass Hive
raw.description: Five narrow recursive layers produce a brittle, animated harmonic cloud.

raw.label: Cut Current
raw.description: A wide entry sweep collapses through two sharp nonlinear oscillators.

raw.label: Brass Moth
raw.description: A compact one-turn patch with an 11 Hz flutter and bright offset.
